description: Shifts every pitched value in a pitchfile by a constant number of semitones, writing a new BINARY PITCHFILE (.frq, 'is a pitch file', window count preserved - re-verified tranche 24). Argv 'repitch pchshift pitchfile out.frq transposition' (NO mode token). Content-proven exact: +7 gives 12*log2(out/in) = 7.000 at every pitched window (257.73 -> 386.15 Hz etc.); MARKERS PRESERVED LITERALLY (-2.0 silence and -1.0 unpitched values pass through untouched, verified on the first four windows of the marker probe). transposition CDP-enforced -96..96, verbatim 'Parameter[1] Value (100.000000) out of range (-96.000000 to 96.000000)' (same at -100); SCALAR-ONLY, verbatim 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [mi.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' (the banner itself points at 'repitch transpose[f]' for time-varying shifts). Deterministic (byte-identical data chunks 1.3 s apart).
musical_use: Transposition of the pitch DATA rather than the sound - which matters exactly when the data drives something else. Flagship uses: (1) parallel-harmony resynthesis - getpitch 1 -> pchshift +7 (or +3/+4) -> repitch synth/vowels (curated) builds a synthetic harmony voice that sings the tracked melody a fixed interval away, while the original audio stays put; stack shifts (+4, +7) for triadic choirs from one voice. (2) Register-relocation before comparison - combineb 1 ratios between an original and its octave-shifted self are a constant 2.0 (sanity anchor), while pchshift into a target register before combineb against ANOTHER voice keeps the derived transposition contour register-sane. (3) Preparing melody data for vowels/synth in a singable range when the source was tracked an octave off (getpitch octave errors on low material - shift +12 to repair). For transposing the ACTUAL SOUND use curated repitch transposef 3 (formant-preserving) or transpose 3 - this entry never touches audio; for time-varying data shifts the binary refuses breakpoints (use transposef's brk transpos instead).

pitchfile.description: BINARY pitch data (.frq) - getpitch 1's 'pitch_trace.frq' by bare name or a chained .frq by graph-relative path. Typed infile: text refuses 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (family-verified).

transposition.description: Constant shift in (possibly fractional) semitones, CDP-enforced -96..96 (verbatim refusals at +/-100 pinned). Exactness verified: +7 -> 7.000 st at every pitched window. SCALAR-ONLY ('Cannot read parameter 1 [mi.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' verbatim) - the banner routes time-varying shifts to repitch transpose[f].

examples.description: Synthetic parallel fifth from one voice.
examples.expected_use: Feed the output .frq to repitch synth (curated) with a soft harmonic recipe and mix under the original - a harmony voice that tracks every inflection exactly (shift verified 7.000 st per window).

examples.description: Repair an octave-down tracking error before vowel resynthesis.
examples.expected_use: getpitch sometimes locks an octave low on rich bass material; +12 relocates the data into the true register for repitch vowels.

known_issues: Data-only transform: the ORIGINAL sound is untouched - to transpose audio use curated repitch transposef 3 (formant-preserving). This entry's output feeds synth/vowels/combineb/other transforms.
SCALAR-ONLY transposition (verbatim brk refusal pinned); the banner itself defers time-varying shifts to repitch transpose[f].
Markers preserved literally (-1/-2 unchanged, verified) - marker-laden files stay marker-laden; downstream consumers that refuse markers (pitchinfo convert) still refuse.
Output is DATA (.frq): pre-flight skipped, verify = exists+non-empty; not auditionable directly (resynthesize via repitch synth to hear it).
